notes:
Stop a missing keystore from failing deep inside Gradle

APK release run #1 died at `assembleRelease` with a message about a
tampered keystore. The cause was upstream: `base64 -d` on an unset
secret writes an empty file and exits 0, so the decode step passed and
Gradle inherited the problem. Check the four secrets are present and
that keytool can actually open the store with that password and alias,
and name what is missing when it cannot.

That run also built from the repository's default branch, which is not
main, so a signed release would have been published from unrelated code.
Refuse any ref that is not main or a v* tag.

Also stop the debug APK rebuilding twice per push: the OTA workflow
commits the bundle to main right after, which retriggered it — with a
freshly generated debug key, so the two APKs of one push did not even
share a signature.
